title: Nonnegativity of walk transition probabilities
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and $u,v$ vertices of $G$. The probability that a walk starting at $u$, with its successive neighbor indices chosen uniformly from the $D$ possibilities, ends at $v$ after $k$ steps is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D$
